symbols.name: group
symbols.meaning: The group in which the order of sigma is taken, a set with an associative operation, an identity, and inverses.
symbols.quote: Let $G$ be a group, a set with an associative operation, an identity element $1$ and an inverse for each element, and let $\sigma$ be an element of $G$.

symbols.name: element
symbols.meaning: An element of the group G whose powers are taken.
symbols.quote: Let $G$ be a group, a set with an associative operation, an identity element $1$ and an inverse for each element, and let $\sigma$ be an element of $G$.

symbols.name: order
symbols.meaning: The least positive integer with sigma to the power rho equal to 1; it counts the distinct powers of sigma.
symbols.quote: The order of $\sigma$, written $\rho$, is the least positive integer with $\sigma^\rho = 1$.

symbols.name: indeterminate
symbols.meaning: The indeterminate of the ring C[x] modulo x^S minus 1, whose image the map sends to a product of axis indeterminates.
symbols.quote: Here $x$ is the indeterminate of $\mathbb{C}[x]/(x^S-1)$, and $x_i$ is the indeterminate of axis $i$; the letter $x$ changes meaning from earlier pages.

symbols.name: axis indeterminate
symbols.meaning: The indeterminate of axis i, the variable of the i-th cyclic factor of the target ring.
symbols.quote: Here $x$ is the indeterminate of $\mathbb{C}[x]/(x^S-1)$, and $x_i$ is the indeterminate of axis $i$; the letter $x$ changes meaning from earlier pages.

symbols.name: Chinese-remainder map
symbols.meaning: The map sending x to the product of the axis indeterminates raised to the powers mu_i.
symbols.quote: The map $\Phi$ sends $x$ to $\prod_i x_i^{\mu_i}$, where each $\mu_i$ is an inverse, modulo $s_i$, of the product of the lengths before axis $i$.

relations.quote: Within a [cyclic group](cyclic-group.md), the order of an element is the size of the group that the element generates.
